chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying:
And in Sūrat al-Anfāl there is cutting off the nose.

key_terms.النَّفْلُ: That which is additional or extra; the term used here to explain al-Anfāl.
key_terms.الْأَنْفَالُ: The spoils or surplus gains discussed in the hadith and chapter context.
key_terms.جَدْعُ الْأَنْفِ: Literally, cutting off the nose; an Arabic expression used in the hadith.
key_terms.سُورَةِ الْأَنْفَالِ: Sūrat al-Anfāl, the Quranic chapter mentioned in the report.

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام say about the meaning of al-Anfāl?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a brief explanation of the term al-Anfāl and links it to the wording and meaning associated with Sūrat al-Anfāl. It reflects an interpretive statement by Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام within the broader discussion of al-fayʾ, al-anfāl, and khums in Shia hadith literature.
